description: Histeries guardrails. Optional: Codex runs project hooks only after they are reviewed and trusted (/hooks). AGENTS.md never depends on them. Each command fails open (exit 0) when the repository, the script or python3 cannot be found, because a hook that cannot start must never block a tool call.

hooks.command: r="$(jj root 2>/dev/null || git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)"; s="$r/.codex/hooks/session_context.py"; if [ -n "$r" ] && [ -f "$s" ] && command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 "$s"; fi; exit 0

r="$(jj root 2>/dev/null || git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)"; s="$r/.codex/hooks/pre_compact.py"; if [ -n "$r" ] && [ -f "$s" ] && command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 "$s"; fi; exit 0

r="$(jj root 2>/dev/null || git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)"; s="$r/.codex/hooks/guard_git.py"; if [ -n "$r" ] && [ -f "$s" ] && command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 "$s"; fi; exit 0
